Class PostgresDataSource

java.lang.Object
org.postgresql.ds.common.BaseDataSource
org.postgresql.ds.PGSimpleDataSource
org.conical.common.bbl.db.PostgresDataSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Wrapper, Referenceable, CommonDataSource, DataSource
public class PostgresDataSource extends org.postgresql.ds.PGSimpleDataSource
An extension of PGSimpleDataSource that allows caller to assign settings via a postgresql connection URL, rather than specifying the server name, port and database name separately.
Author:
rdoherty
